verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships an official `local-ai` CLI with documented subcommands: `local-ai run` for models from HuggingFace or Ollama URIs, `local-ai models list` for the gallery, and CLI flags such as `--external-grpc-backends` and `--preload-models`. It also includes an AI-native `local-ai chat` shell agent that reads files and runs commands behind an approval gate, documented in both the docs and the GitHub README. Missing for 10: a comprehensive CLI command reference in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI agent workflow.
